thresholds.selection_rule: 10-01 cost study (bot-strategy#1093 comment 5929578203): Binance premium-dev filter thr 0.25 bp = -0.61 bp per $ (halves -0.62 / -0.58) vs baseline -1.09 bp; chosen by hand from thr in {1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.0} as the smallest cost with ~40% of volume kept; NOT re-fitted on the #1113 tape

provenance.rule: xsim.py dev_rule(th=0.25): DEV = prem - EMA_60s(prem), prem = (log arcus_mid - log binance_mid) * 1e4 on a 0.1 s grid; quote the bid iff DEV < 0.25, quote the ask iff DEV > -0.25
provenance.derivation: rf_common pdev_bn_60s = -(prem - EMA_60s(prem)) = -DEV. Side-oriented input x = s * pdev_bn_60s with s = +1 bid / -1 ask. Bid: quote iff DEV < 0.25 <=> x > -0.25. Ask: quote iff DEV > -0.25 <=> x > -0.25. So pred_bps = 1.0 * x (intercept 0, every other coefficient 0) and the frozen threshold is quote_bps = -0.25: quote iff pred_bps >= -0.25, else pull. (The tie DEV == 0.25 differs from the strict inequality of xsim by one grid value; immaterial.)
provenance.validation: 10-01 2 h tape (xtape_20261001.jsonl.gz sha256 3cf39259ca52b6801705d14d711d6df7a0276de2ae94e3687f51c840af4147c9), replay sim xsim.py calibrated to live run 2 (-1.12 bp realized vs -1.09 bp sim): baseline -1.09 bp/$ on $4.1M, this rule -0.61 bp/$ on $1.6M, both hours -0.62 / -0.58. Adding a Binance 1 s return filter (|bn_ret_1s| < 0.25 bp, an AND rule, not expressible as one linear threshold) gave -0.49 bp/$; that is the ~-0.5 bp figure quoted on #1120. theta is the 10-01 validation value, not re-fitted on the #1113 forward tape (whose Binance records include size-only updates every 250 ms; CUTOFF 7). Not validated on the Tokyo host (Binance latency differs from the Berlin workstation): shadow mode first (design D8).
provenance.feature_definitions: bot-strategy#1113 rf_common.py (sha256 e9173c7dbb4fadce4d2e4f04d1bbc9c5435380cf8930ee8071f474ace2b9f0b8), CUTOFF.md section 4; rx < tau strict, grid 0.1 s, EMA lfilter zi=(1-a)x[0]
provenance.scope: venue=arcus market=BTC-USD only. Arcus SPY-USD (and the other equity/ETF/commodity perps) has NO Binance/Hyperliquid reference for its underlying: this file is refused there (market mismatch) and the runtime records Fallback(model_missing) on every cycle by design. SPY needs (1) a lead-lag study of the candidate references (Lighter index, Polymarket idx, Nado bbo; DESIGN.md section 8 / Q4), (2) a feature engine variant with that reference in place of Binance/HL plus session flags, (3) its own frozen train/validation cell, before a quote_gate_*_arcus_spy.json can exist.
provenance.exporter: hand-written from the study scripts (no models.pkl exists for the linear 10-01 rule); pairtrade PR for bot-strategy#1120
provenance.validation_caveat_20261009: bot-strategy#1113 trainval of 2026-10-09 14:14Z on the NEW forward tape (2026-10-02..10-07, Binance recorded with size-only updates every 250 ms): the same linear premium-dev filter re-fitted on train barely helps on validation at q=0.5 (volume-weighted 30 s markout -1.225 -> -1.199 bp, 32% of maker volume retained; the RandomForest reached -0.904 bp at 26%). The 10-01 figure (-1.09 -> -0.61 bp/$) therefore must NOT be assumed for the shipped theta; it is only the 10-01 validation value kept for the shadow week, and the shadow readout (design section 10) decides whether this rule, the RF, or neither goes to enforce.
